description: Catalog of every Rank capability and the surfaces that document it. The CLI, the MCP server, and the Convex HTTP routes are implemented separately and checked against this file; `pnpm check:surfaces` verifies names, routes, and manifest references by source inspection, not runtime parity. A shared entry means the same subject on each surface, not identical behavior — see per-surface scope notes. A surface marked planned is declared intent with a recorded reason, not an implementation.

capabilities.title: Environment preflight
capabilities.summary: Resolve every environment variable Rank reads and report what is missing per pipeline stage. Scope differs by surface: the CLI reads the linked deployment unless --local is passed, the MCP tool reads local sources only, and the HTTP route reports deployment presence through a Convex query.

capabilities.title: Describe Rank environment
capabilities.summary: List every environment variable Rank reads, who consumes it, and what breaks without it.

capabilities.title: List Rank capabilities
capabilities.summary: List every capability and the CLI command, MCP tool, and HTTP route that expose it.

capabilities.title: Evaluate one prospect
capabilities.summary: Judge one prospect against the brand and save a human-reviewable result. Evaluate and persist only: no outreach, no cross-owner reads. HTTP is deferred: no external client needs it and no authenticated public-route pattern exists yet.

http.reason: Deferred: no external HTTP client needs this operation and no authenticated public-route pattern exists. Revisit when a non-Convex client requires it.
